headline: US Forces Disable Blockade-Running Vessel as Regional Wars Escalate on Multiple Fronts
subheadline: Explosions echoed through the Strait of Hormuz at 21:04 local time as US aircraft disabled a vessel attempting to breach the blockade from Bandar Abbas.
lede: Explosions rocked the Strait of Hormuz at 21:04 local time as US aircraft disabled a vessel attempting to breach the blockade from Bandar Abbas, while the USS Makin Island ARG with the 13th MEU deployed to the Indian Ocean. A Saudi-led coalition destroyed 50 Houthi military targets across Sanaa, Hodeidah, and Saada governorates in Yemen. Israeli warplanes struck four Hamas weapon depots in Gaza and targeted the son of Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Gaza City's Rimal neighborhood, wounding six Palestinians, while strikes and artillery hit southern Lebanon near Kfar Tibnit, Zoutar Al-Sharqiya, and Mayfdon. Overnight, Russia launched reactive UAVs from Guardiyske, Orel, and Bryansk across ten Ukrainian regions.

sections.title: Mass Russian Drone Wave Strikes Ten Regions
sections.body: Russia launched reactive UAVs detected over Chernihiv, Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, Khmelnytskyi, Rivne, Zhytomyr, and Kirovohrad regions overnight, with launches recorded from Guardiyske (3-4 groups) and Orel (2 groups), plus three new drones from Bryansk toward Chernihiv. Germany's 2027 budget allocates 11.6 billion euros for Ukrainian military aid, including IRIS-T, Patriot, PAC-3 missiles, Gepard maintenance, and 20 million euros for drone interceptors. Ukraine presented Black Sea ceasefire conditions for safe navigation and grain export, while Russia demands oil export inclusion. Nine children were returned from occupied Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, and Crimea, bringing the total to 2,875.

sections.title: Multi-Front Strikes Hit Yemen, Gaza, Lebanon
sections.body: The Saudi-led coalition destroyed 50 Houthi military targets across Sanaa, Hodeidah, and Saada governorates in Yemen. The Israeli Air Force bombed four Hamas weapon depots across the Gaza Strip and targeted the youngest son of Hamas chief Khalil al-Hayya in Gaza City's Rimal neighborhood, wounding six Palestinians. Israeli warplanes attacked near Kfar Tibnit near Nabatieh in southern Lebanon, with artillery shelling reported in Zoutar Al-Sharqiya and Mayfdon. In the Strait of Hormuz, explosions were heard at 21:04 local time as US aircraft disabled a vessel attempting to breach the blockade from Bandar Abbas.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Simultaneous escalation across multiple fronts signals heightened regional volatility, with the Saudi-led coalition sustaining pressure on Houthi capabilities while Israel expands from Gaza leadership decapitation attempts into southern Lebanon. Naval tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and UAV activity over western Iran point to widening maritime and aerial confrontation zones, reinforced by the USS Makin Island ARG deployment. In Ukraine, launches from three Russian sites across ten regions indicate a sustained mass-drone strategy, while Germany's locked-in 2027 aid offers air defense predictability against evolving threats.
